en: A vintage, colored postcard view of a broad cobblestone street with tram tracks, lined with multi‑story historic buildings and shops. Many pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks and street. A distinctive corner building with a tall, steep roof and decorative façade dominates the center-right. At the top left of the postcard, multilingual text names the city and the street.
